name: Seduced by the Rhythm
source:
Balancing her career as a choreographer and the care of her younger sister, Molly, Michelle guides her exotic dancers toward a crucial contest. But as love, rivalry, and old grudges collide, she must face the possibility of a devastating farewell.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Seduced_by_the_Rhythm]romance-club.fandom[/url]
